description: CDPHE Health Facilities is published by CDPHE - Department of Public Health and Environment. The geospatial layer locates regulated health facilities using addresses supplied by the state health department. Its stated coverage is Colorado, United States; geocoded facility points from January 2017 source addresses. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. Geocoding and the age of the source addresses limit current location accuracy. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
